reasons: Claimed status is compliant, and consistent with that status the proposal contains no redline and no counterparty comment — the rendered text is identical to the originals.

The cited paragraphs support compliance: p0084 imposes only ordinary fee payment per the Fee Schedule, p0118 grants Customer (Sparkling) termination for convenience on 90 days' notice with no termination charge or minimum-fee obligation, and p0128 runs money the other way (perpetual fee-free licence plus refund on Vendor default).

No Customer-payable liquidated damages, penalty or early-termination/minimum fee appears in the cited text, so the preferred position ('No liquidated damages or penalties payable by Customer') is met and no negotiation issue should be raised.
Deterministic checks are empty and no directional error is present; the rationale correctly notes that amounts payable by Garman to Sparkling are compliant under the rule's detection guidance.
